description: This file implements a shared data store using multiprocessing managers, including classes for server and client managers, a stash class for key-value storage with destructive 'take' semantics, and functions for environment configuration and server management.

classes.name: ServerDictManager
classes.description: A manager class for shared dictionary data, registering 'get_dict' method.

classes.name: ClientDictManager
classes.description: A client manager class for accessing shared dictionary data.

classes.name: StashServer
classes.description: Manages server-side shared data, including starting and shutting down the server.

classes.name: Stash
classes.description: A key-value store for persisting data across HTTP/S and WS/S requests with write-once, read-once semantics.

classes.name: StashError
classes.description: Custom exception class for stash-related errors.

methods.name: _get_shared
methods.description: Returns the shared data dictionary from ServerDictManager.

methods.name: load_env_config
methods.description: Loads environment configuration for the stash from WPT_STASH_CONFIG environment variable.

methods.name: store_env_config
methods.description: Stores environment configuration for the stash into WPT_STASH_CONFIG environment variable.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Initializes and starts a server manager with optional address and authkey.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes server or stash objects with address, authkey, or default path.

methods.name: _get_proxy
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a proxy dictionary for shared data.

methods.name: _wrap_key
methods.description: Creates a tuple key combining path and UUID for storage.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the shared stash with a UUID key and optional path.

methods.name: take
methods.description: Removes and returns a value from the shared stash by key and optional path.
